Dosage Form(s): This monograph excludes foods or food-like dosage forms as indicated in the Compendium of Monographs Guidance Document.
Dosage forms must be suited for buccal administration which allow for direct contact between the affected tissue and the medicinal ingredient: Gargle; Liquid; Mouthwash.

Use(s) or Purpose(s): (Used in Herbal Medicine (as a demulcent) to) help(s) relieve minor inflammations of mucous membranes of the mouth (such as canker sores) (Pizzorno and Murray 2006; Bruneton 1999; Das et al. 1989).

Quantity(ies): Method of preparation: Prepared and dry

Direction(s) for use: Rinse and/or gargle, 4 times per day (Das et al. 1989).
Caution(s) and warning(s): Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician if symptoms persist or worsen.
